title: Ensemble: R_r18d + R_e600 (greedy search over 62 combinations)
hypothesis: Averaging the two best ResNet18 variants should beat each alone.

config.search: all combinations of 1-4 models, OOF macro F1

results.name: OOF ensemble (v4+rot)
results.note: best of 62 combinations on the same OOF: optimistic

findings: Public 0.80694: OOF gain (+0.02) carried over, and this was the first submission above 0.80.
The combination was chosen on OOF, so the OOF value is optimistic.
limitations: Selection on the same OOF that is reported.
